title: EPF Calculator
shortAnswer: Estimate your Employee Provident Fund corpus.
longAnswer: The EPF Calculator estimates the retirement corpus from your Employees' Provident Fund contributions. Each month, you contribute 12% of basic plus dearness allowance, and your employer contributes 12%, of which 8.33% goes to the Employees' Pension Scheme and 3.67% to the EPF. The calculator projects the balance to retirement using your current balance, monthly contribution, expected salary growth, and the EPF interest rate (declared annually, currently around 8.25%). EPF interest is tax-free on accrual, and the maturity amount is tax-free if you have five years of continuous service. Contributions qualify for deduction under Section 80C, within the ₹1.5 lakh limit. The result is an estimate—the actual rate is declared each year and the projection assumes a constant rate. Withdrawals before five years are taxable. Confirm your passbook balance on the EPFO portal before relying on the projection.
